Title: A Cold Welcome
Description: Skye is reporting news of unusual Varangian activity in Great Cleave. Go to investigate and put a stop to their plans.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_grace_goaway" />Damned if I know! Seems our Spear Daughter wants your ear alone - as if the rest of us lot<g id="g_grace_shrugdontknow" /> were untrustworthy.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />Let me know what you find out.<g id="g_grace_convince1" /> And remember, it's 'in business,' not 'in charity!'
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_grace_crossarms" priority="high" />Mordred. Son of Morgaine! I've heard plenty about him, and none of it good. And<g id="g_grace_headshakeno" /> now he's after some relics.

Title: Daichi Saito
Description: Grace O'Malley wants to add more firepower to the team. Find Daichi Saito and recruit him to the Silver Crows.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_grace_proud" />Yeah, and literally, someone with magical fire. It’s a powerful element, I’m sure you’d agree.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_grace_spreadarms" />Always good to bring more hands on deck, but our coffers are getting a bit dusty.<g id="g_grace_no" /> Might need to trim our sails.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_grace_flirt" />Well, congratulations on hiring Daichi. He's no doubt a powerful add to the team.<g id="g_grace_headtilthmm" /> It's just-

Title: The Ice Castle
Description: Work with Daichi Saito to find a way into the legendary Ice Castle, and look for the Frost Crown.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_grace_understand" />Good idea. Bound to find some small fishing or supply boats that way. I'll meet you on the island with the others.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_grace_lean" />Let’s keep an eye out for any interesting items in that Ice Castle. I’m certainly not hoping for any<g id="g_grace_gesturerightm" /> rewards from mad King Idris.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_grace_shrugdontknow" />All things considered, a<g id="g_grace_headnodyes" /> job well done. But<g id="g_grace_concerns" priority="high" /> make no mistake, we’re deep in the pickle brine now.

Title: The Mage
Description: Morgaine spoke of a mage who obtained the Staff of Samhain, the final artifact needed to empower Mordred and bring on an endless winter. Get the staff from the mage before Mordred does.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_grace_understand" />Great idea. That way we've got a better chance of getting either the rune or the staff.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_grace_sorry" />We'll let you know what we find out about the Winter Rune. Ah, it might be time to start<g id="g_grace_no" /> fortifying the camp.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_grace_upset" priority="high" />Cat's curse. Mordred's got everything he needs to turn us all into icicles, save the rune. We'll<g id="g_grace_headnodyes" /> need to move fast.<g id="g_grace_shrugdontknow" /> Brr. Is<g id="g_grace_cantremember" priority="high" /> it just me, or did it get colder here, all of a sudden?

Title: The Winter Rune
Description: Get the Winter Rune that binds the three winter artifacts together, before Mordred gets to it.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Great Cleave-<g id="g_grace_relief" /> what? Don't tell me you just guessed that. All right, don't<g id="g_grace_dismiss2" priority="high" /> make a display of yourself.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_grace_convince1" />Just when things were getting quiet again. I knew I couldn't trust it. Why can't we have a nice, fat, boring,<g id="g_grace_shrugdontcare" /> purse-fattening contract?
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: This Mordred-<g id="g_yonas_explain01" /> he does not know it, but something cold, hungry, a terror- it breaks free of its tether, in a place that<g id="g_yonas_shakehead" priority="high" /> shadows our world.

Title: Eternal Frost
Description: Mordred has everything he needs to activate the Ancient device and become a winter demigod. Stop him before he brings about an Ice Age to Aeternum, and the rest of the world.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_yonas_shrug" />I thought everyone already knew this. The<g id="g_yonas_lefthand" /> waterfalls, the mountain shape-<g id="g_yonas_gesturebothhands" /> Mokosh.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_yonas_noddingheadapproval" />Skye may know a way to find Morgaine. You know, I like Skye very much.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" />If we were betting odds, I<g id="g_grace_headshakeno" priority="high" /> might have wagered against us.

Title: From Client to Crow
Description: Mordred has been stopped, and another crisis averted, for now. Share the news with his mother, Morgaine.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: <g id="g_grace_understand" />I was hoping you'd say so. Skye just came back, says she tried approaching her, but the sorceress had her jaw set.
InProgressResponse: <g id="g_grace_cantremember" />To think this entire place, maybe the whole world, would be covered in ice, if it<g id="g_grace_gesturebothhands" /> wasn't for the Silver Crows.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: <g id="g_grace_gesturer" />Seems I just missed it. How did the talk with Morgaine go?<g id="g_grace_consider" priority="high" /> Wonder if we could still ask her for some eh, reasonable compensation.

Title: The Glacial Tarn (Expedition)
Description: Shailyn has found another way into the underground caverns in Great Cleave. She wants you to pursue Ser Loth and destroy him.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: Yes, right through this gateway, in fact. But as you can imagine, there's more in the way of getting to Loth than just this door.
InProgressResponse: Though the challenge before us is mighty, I can think of none more able to face it, than you.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: You've done it. You've actually, actually done it. Forgive me. I- I have spent a lifetime, pursuing that vile bastard, Loth.

Title: The Ice of Life (Expedition)
Description: The healer Ao Wei, is interested in the potential for curative powers of ice found in the Glacial Tarn in Great Cleave. He wants you to collect samples of any interesting ice formations that you find deep in the caverns.
ObjectiveProposalResponse: That is correct! But this ice- it has properties unlike anything I have ever seen. Is it the purity of the water?
InProgressResponse: Beyond its healing properties, I believe these ice formations hold a secret to our life here on Aeternum.
DestinationCompletionAvailableResponse: Ah! I see you have returned! And you have the ice formations! Excellent! I knew you were the right person to ask for aid!
ObjectiveOnCooldownResponse: With the ice sample you've collected I'll be able to whip up more healing tinctures. Come back soon and I'll be happy to pay you again for your aid.
